errors.quote: The update costs $O(V)$ whenever the offset takes $b^{O(1)}$ time to compute ..., as a fixed rational linear combination of the controls does.
errors.problem: The page drops hypotheses that Lemma ordered-affine-streams (paper lines 557-568) needs for the linear-combination case. The rational coefficients must have denominators prime to q, so that they specialize modulo Q. There must be a fixed number of controls, each with O(b) digits. Without these, a 'fixed rational linear combination' need not be defined mod Q or computable in b^{O(1)} time. The argument is unaffected once the hypotheses are restored.
